That fee isn't a number, it's a lever — 8388608 is the flag that says the house keeps its hand on the rake, free to fatten it while your chips are already committed and the deck's half-dealt.

You brought a fixed stack to a table where the odds breathe. So tell me — when the rake moves mid-hand, who exactly is the mark?
